title: 6 days.
Endless possibilities.
core.text: A full week is our reference format — but it is only that: a reference. Dates, duration, activities and the daily programme are shaped around your group.

terrain.title: Wild mountains, still off the map.
terrain.text: The Šar Mountains rise above Popova Shapka in the west of North Macedonia: open alpine faces, long ridgelines, trees and couloirs, in a region still untouched by mass tourism. Some days the snowcat takes you almost to the top; the rest of the mountain is yours.

difference.title: We don't resell this trip. We run it.

title: Our snowcat.

snowcat.text: A PistenBully PB300W, adapted for passenger transport, with a dedicated cabin to carry your group up the mountain. No queues, no lifts — just the next line.

stay.title: Simple, warm, local.
stay.text: A small, family-run hotel above Popova Shapka, where the snowcat can leave from the door. Full board with generous Balkan cooking, a sauna for tired legs and evenings around the table. Comfortable and welcoming — the Balkans, not a luxury resort.

team.title: Local people matter.
team.text: The snowcat operation runs through Wild Tracks, the local structure we developed with our partners in North Macedonia. It looks after the machine on site, reservations, accommodation, logistics and the day-to-day organisation on the ground. OrganixEvents remains your organiser, from the first message to the last day.

items.a: Approximately from late December to early April, depending on snow conditions. Our principal 2027 period runs from 16 January to 3 April — other dates may be possible, just ask.

items.q: Do I have to come for a full week?
items.a: No. The Saturday-to-Saturday week is our reference format. We can organise 3, 4 or 5 days, a full week or another duration.

It's the reference price per person for the full-week experience with a group of 8: 6 ski days, 7 days accommodation and full board. For shorter stays, other group sizes or private arrangements, we'll send you a tailored offer.
Groups generally stop around 10 guests. 12 is the absolute maximum.

items.q: I'm travelling alone. Can I join?
items.a: Get in touch. You may be able to join an existing group, depending on availability, skiing level, group compatibility and the agreement of that group.
A local certified mountain professional, together with a professional member of the Organix team.

items.q: Who runs the operation on the ground?
items.a: Wild Tracks, the local structure we developed with our partners in North Macedonia. It manages the snowcat on site, reservations, accommodation and logistics. OrganixEvents organises your trip and stays your contact throughout.

Send us an enquiry and we'll talk it through. We then send you the registration form; once it's validated, you pay Organix directly in CHF or EUR and your trip is confirmed. There's no online checkout.

items.q: What do I need to bring?
items.a: Your ski or snowboard equipment and your avalanche safety equipment: airbag, transceiver, probe and shovel. We'll send you a full list with your registration.
